svg.title: F-04 guide-word scenes
svg.desc: Guide-word scenes for F-04 Predict the motion of other road users. M01 No function: No prediction; road users are taken as standing still and the vehicle does not slow for one moving into its path (H-02). M02 Stops functioning: Prediction stops; same as no function (H-02, rated as M01). M04 Function stuck: Predictions frozen; road users that change course are missed as in M01 (H-02, rated as M01). M05 Excessive function: Predicted conflict larger than real; the vehicle brakes hard for a road user that would not have crossed (H-03). M06 Partial function: Predicted conflict smaller than real; the vehicle enters a conflict area a crossing road user has the right of way to (H-06). M08 Functions late: Prediction late; as no prediction for the moment that matters (H-02, rated as M01). M11 Delayed: Latency; as M08 (H-02, rated as M01). M12 Inverse function: Direction of a road user reversed; its conflict is missed as in M06 (H-06, rated as M06). M13 Erratic or intermittent: Predictions jump; each spurious conflict acts as M05 (H-03, rated as M05).
svg.text: F-04 Predict the motion of other road users: what each malfunction does
WP-C-03 §6.1, Figure 6-4 (F-04): the 9 safety-related guide words, 3 rated and 6 folded into another. Schematic, not simulation results.
